source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Spend 1 CP as your Command phase ends, picking a GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit of yours that is outside Engagement Range of every enemy unit. Provided it has Deep Strike, you may move it into Strategic Reserves. A designer's note says the point is to let that unit react to your missions and objectives and to use abilities that keep objective markers under your control.

effects.condition: unit has the Deep Strike ability

stratagem.designerNote: Intended to let the unit use abilities that keep control of objective markers and to react to missions and objectives.
